> @copilot 仔细评估是否已经完成了所有开发要求并解决以下问题18:29:15.763 @objectstack/spec:build:   ✓ data/TenantDatabaseLifecycle.json
> 18:30:11.838 @objectstack/cli:build: src/...

Fixed in `8e31dd9`. The CLI package uses `tsc` for building (not `tsup`), so a static string literal in `import('@objectstack/service-i18n')` causes TS2307 when the package isn't in CLI's dependencies. Used a variable indirection (`const i18nPkg = '@objectstack/service-i18n'; await import(i18nPkg)`) to prevent tsc from attempting module resolution at compile time — matching how other truly optional dynamic imports work. Full monorepo build (all 37 packages) now passes.
